answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the opal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. The raven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the plume is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
